network_status.network: ARPAE regional tele-hydrometric network and validated event report
network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto validato 16-18 maggio descrive la piena regionale e le principali aste monitorate, ma non pubblica una sezione idrometrica sul canale Magni compatibile con questo ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The validated 16-18 May report describes the regional flood and the main monitored rivers, but publishes no gauge section on the Magni canal compatible with this bridge.

sources.title: Alluvione in Emilia, l'acqua distrugge il ponte a Prada
Cronaca meteo - Prada (RA), ponte crollato: le immagini dal drone

curation_note.it: La revisione del rapporto ufficiale conferma il contesto di piena, ma non una misura sul canale Magni. Il dossier è quindi completo come gap verificato: nessun livello o portata viene trasferito dalle aste maggiori vicine.
curation_note.en: Review of the official report confirms the flood context, but not a measurement on the Magni canal. The dossier is therefore complete as a verified gap: no stage or discharge is transferred from nearby major rivers.

provenance.method: Manual extraction and coverage review of the official validated event report

caveats: No compatible event-specific gauge section for the Magni canal is published in the reviewed ARPAE event report.
The absence of a published compatible measurement does not imply absence of flooding at the bridge.
Hydrometric values from the Lamone, Marzeno or other nearby monitored rivers are not transferred to this canal.
The probable failure-process label retains the evidence level of the controlled event database and is not upgraded by the regional report.
